sources.finding: macOS 14 floor; targets Kooky (app), KookyKit, KookyHook, kooky-cli and KookyHookKit; links GhosttyKit; no other platform.

sources.title: Built-in agent templates
sources.finding: Templates for terminal, claude-code, codex, gemini, opencode, amp, cursor, copilot, grok, antigravity, kimi, pi, omp, reasonix, kiro and droid; each launches the vendor CLI under a shell wrapper and resumes by exact conversation ID.

sources.title: Custom agents and environment
sources.finding: User-defined agents (name + command, optional built-in base) with per-agent .env-style environment variables for Claude-based entries; KOOKY_-prefixed keys are dropped.

sources.title: Hook wiring for agents
sources.finding: Kooky passes a generated hooks file to claude with --settings and writes managed hook blocks for other agents so lifecycle events reach the app.

sources.title: Local unix socket server
sources.finding: App owns a unix socket (mode 0600) that the hook helper and kooky-cli connect to; no network listener.

sources.title: CLI wire protocol
sources.finding: Verbs: open, resume, list, focus, close, status, rename; versioned envelope.

sources.title: CLI request handling
sources.finding: Dispatches list, close, open, resume, focus, rename; refuses a protocol version newer than the app.

sources.title: kooky-cli entry point
sources.finding: kooky-cli parses verbs and prints one reason line on failure; exit code 0 means accepted.

sources.title: kooky:// deep links
sources.finding: kooky://resume?agent=&id=[&cwd=] with strict character validation; links cannot carry prompts or commands.

sources.title: Agent session history
sources.finding: Scans each agent own transcript directory (for example ~/.claude/projects and ~/.codex/sessions) to list and resume past conversations; read-only.

sources.title: Codex usage gauge
sources.finding: Reads Codex rollout token_count events for 5-hour and weekly rate-limit percentages, plan type and context-window occupancy; display only.

sources.title: Git worktree manager
sources.finding: Creates worktrees on a new or existing branch, adopts existing ones, removes with optional branch delete.

sources.title: SSH workspace wrapper
sources.finding: SSH workspaces use ssh with ControlMaster multiplexing; every tab runs a plain ssh session and agents are started on the remote through the wrapper.

sources.title: New SSH workspace sheet
sources.finding: File menu sheet that records a remote host for a workspace.

sources.title: Keep-awake including closed lid
sources.finding: Fixed two-verb root helper around pmset -a disablesleep with a one-time admin authorization; keeps the Mac awake while agents work.

sources.title: Notification manager
sources.finding: macOS notifications when a background agent waits or a command fails; settings toggle each kind.

sources.title: State persistence
sources.finding: state.json keeps workspaces, panes, cwd, worktree and SSH host; scrollback and processes cannot survive PTY exit, so panes respawn.

sources.title: Update checker
sources.finding: Manual Help menu check calls api.github.com releases/latest; no startup poll; only network call found in the app.

sources.title: Git status and diff pill
sources.finding: Status bar shows branch and git diff --numstat counts; popover lists changed files with insertions and deletions, not diff hunks.

sources.title: Agent panel
sources.finding: Right panel lists every agent across windows sorted attention (waiting), failed, running, idle.

sources.title: Clipboard confirmation
sources.finding: Confirmation sheet before risky paste and OSC 52 clipboard access.

sources.title: Secure keyboard input
sources.finding: Holds macOS secure keyboard input during password entry.

sources.title: Local crash forensics
sources.finding: Writes stderr and exit notes to ~/Library/Logs/kooky/stderr.log; nothing is uploaded.

sources.title: libghostty terminal engine
sources.finding: Terminal sessions render through the libghostty xcframework inside SwiftUI/AppKit views.

sources.title: Session Info panel
sources.finding: Inspector shows git branch/diff, venv, Node version, process tree with CPU and memory, listening ports and last command exit code.

sources.title: Kooky pull requests and discussions
sources.finding: Open pull requests propose Mosh transport, project grouping and SSH ports; no roadmap or announcement.

sources.title: Bounded search: other clients
sources.locator: grep -w over Sources and Package.swift for linux, windows, docker, electron, tauri, webview, WKWebView, iOS, android
sources.finding: No non-macOS client, web client, phone client or editor extension; matches are Swift window objects.

sources.title: Bounded search: APIs, MCP, webhooks, SDK
sources.locator: grep -w for mcp, webhook, openapi, NWListener, GraphQL, sdk over Sources
sources.finding: No MCP server or client, webhook, HTTP API or SDK; only the local unix socket CLI.

sources.title: Bounded search: schedules and triggers
sources.locator: grep -w for cron, launchd, LaunchAgent, crontab over Sources
sources.finding: No scheduler or event trigger.

sources.title: Bounded search: collaboration and enterprise
sources.locator: grep -w for sso, saml, rbac, invite, multiplayer, presence over Sources
sources.finding: No accounts, roles, SSO, sharing or multi-user features.

sources.title: Bounded search: container or VM isolation
sources.locator: grep -w for docker, podman, lima, colima, qemu, virtualization, sandbox-exec, seatbelt over Sources
sources.finding: No container, VM or OS sandbox isolation.

sources.title: Bounded search: cost tracking
sources.locator: grep -w for usd, dollar, spend, budget, totalCost, pricing over Sources
sources.finding: No dollar cost, spend, budget or pricing code; only Codex rate-limit percentages.

sources.title: Bounded search: native issues and tasks
sources.locator: grep -w for ticket, backlog, kanban, epic, jira, linear over Sources
sources.finding: No issue, task or ticket entity; workspaces are folders.

sources.title: Bounded search: delegation and orchestration
sources.locator: grep -w for subagent, orchestrator, orchestration over Sources
sources.finding: No coordinator or delegation tool; kooky-cli is a tab-control interface.

sources.title: Bounded search: pull requests and delivery
sources.locator: grep for gh pr, pull request, createPR, merge request, git commit, git push over Sources
sources.finding: No PR, commit, merge or deploy action; git is used read-only plus worktree and branch switching.

sources.title: Bounded search: telemetry
sources.locator: grep -i for telemetry, analytics, sentry, posthog, mixpanel, crashreport over Sources, README
sources.finding: No analytics or crash-reporting client; README says no telemetry; only the manual GitHub update check.
